## Summary
- bind provider-neutral ACP sessions to existing AgentSession/AgentRun authority
- normalize ACP events, permissions, cancellation, failures, completion evidence, and validation handoff through AgentHost
- expose only read-only Ask and AgentRun-bound Build/Repair MCP authority while preserving the existing canonical_authoring writer path
- keep validation handoff blocked while an ACP permission is unresolved or canonical_authoring is still claimed
- add focused unit test code without running heavy validation in this parallel authoring subtask

## Integration
This branch is based on the ACP Foundation HEAD. Chat 1 transport should implement the existing AcpAgentRuntime/AcpAgentSession contracts and preserve AcpSessionBinding run identity on MCP calls. Provider descriptors from Chats 3-5 remain data-driven.

## Validation
Heavy cargo validation, Windows Validation, and Visual Validation are intentionally deferred to the final ACP integration chat. Canonical producer/build/preflight remains required.
